name: Akabane Mami
source:
Head Nurse of Kusunoki Obstetrics & Gynecology, Gynecology Dept.
-Married
-Mother of two children
-Maternal personality 
-Self-sacrificial 

When the perpetrator appeared, she immediately rushed to the aid of a patient, but was relentlessly raped  by the perpetrator, who used the hostage as a shield.
